phases.name: dawn
phases.message: The sky pales behind the mesas, and a rooster somewhere takes credit for it.

phases.name: day
phases.message: The sun clears the ridge and the heat starts in.

phases.name: high-noon
phases.message: The sun hangs straight overhead, and every shadow shrinks to nothing.

phases.name: afternoon
phases.message: The worst of the heat eases, a little.

phases.name: dusk
phases.message: The sun sinks red into the desert, and shadows stretch long across the street.

phases.name: night
phases.message: Coyotes start up somewhere past the edge of town.
